name: Sereno
owner: A sourdough bakery invented for the lab
idea: The sereno keeps watch at night: a moon of dough, scored like a loaf, and one light on, the oven.
place: A neighbourhood bakery that bakes before dawn

display.role: Name and headlines, with the weight of a loaf

text.role: Labels, hours and the facts of each loaf
text.sample: Country loaf · sourdough · out at 6 am

grid: The moon comes from two circles: the dough, and a second one, shifted, that bites it.
The score is the module: three parallel scores, each centred on the same ring.
The light is two modules wide, touches the circle from inside and sets the clear space.

alt.logo: Sereno logo: a moon of dough with three scores and one light, above the name
alt.secondary: Horizontal version: the moon, the name and “Bread before dawn” on one line
alt.patterns: Three patterns: bread scores, phases of the moon and ears of wheat
alt.post: Sample post: “While you sleep, we bake” beside the moon, on orange
alt.story: Sample story: one loaf's night, from feeding the starter to warm bread
alt.poster: Sample poster: the moon over the sleeping street and a single lit window
alt.print: Sample hang tag in the shape of an oven mouth
alt.object: Bread box in 3D: the moon on the front and loaf scores on the lid

source: Sereno is a brand exercise invented for the lab: the logo, the palette, the chosen typefaces and every piece were drawn for this board, with sample copy.
